fato_historico: 1991: Cambodian Prince Norodom Sihanouk returns to Phnom Penh after thirteen years in exile.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a beautiful homecoming to your inner spirit, Scorpio. Much like a long-awaited return to familiar lands after a period of solitude, you might find that your heart is finally ready to settle into peace. It is a good time to embrace your transformation and welcome the warmth of new, hopeful beginnings into your life.
frase_do_dia: Every step away from your shadows leads you closer to your brightest sun.
significado_numero: A powerful symbol of transition and the start of a new chapter.
conselho: Consider letting go of old worries to make space for fresh, lucky opportunities today.
